title: The Reliance Hypothesis: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness Rises as Language Resource Level Falls
abstract: arXiv:2610.22841v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) faithfulness matters for monitoring, explaining and safely deploying large language models, yet it has been studied mostly in English. Languages differ in level, the amount of text available to learn from, so models know less in lower-resource languages, which may change how much they rely on their reasoning. To our knowledge, we are the first to relate CoT faithfulness to both resource level and task type (knowledge- or reasoning-intensive). On parallel multiple-choice questions from Multilingual Massive Multitask Language Understanding (MMMLU) in eight languages, faithfulness rises as resource level falls on knowledge-intensive tasks but not on reasoning-intensive ones, a gap that points the same way across four models and several faithfulness measures. We propose, and find support for, the Reliance Hypothesis: models rely more on their reasoning when they cannot recall the answer, as in lower-resource language

translated_title: 依赖假设：随着语言资源水平的下降，思维链的忠实度上升
translated_abstract: 思维链的忠实度对于监控、解释和安全部署大型语言模型至关重要，然而目前的研究大多集中在英语上。语言之间存在资源水平的差异，即可用于学习的文本数量不同，因此模型在低资源语言中掌握的知识较少，这可能改变它们对自身推理的依赖程度。据我们所知，我们是首个将CoT忠实度同时与资源水平和任务类型（知识密集型或推理密集型）关联起来的研究。在来自多语言大规模多任务语言理解（MMMLU）基准的八种语言的平行多项选择题上，忠实度在知识密集型任务上随着资源水平的下降而上升，但在推理密集型任务上并非如此，这一差异在四个模型和多种忠实度度量上均呈现出相同的方向。我们提出并找到了支持“依赖假设”的证据：当模型无法回忆起答案时（例如在低资源语言中），它们会更加依赖自己的推理。
tldr: 论文提出“依赖假设”：当模型无法回忆答案时会更加依赖思维链推理，因此CoT忠实度在知识密集型任务上随语言资源水平的下降而上升。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Reliance Hypothesis: models rely more on their Chain-of-Thought reasoning when they cannot recall the answer, so CoT faithfulness rises as language resource level falls on knowledge-intensive tasks.
